entries.source: Staatsarchiv Ludwigsburg, Bestand JL 425, Sammlung Breitenbach, Bd. II, Qu. 3; Bd. XIX, Qu. 40 (references in the Personenindex)
entries.german: Pfahl von Grünsfeld – Anna, Frau des Johann – (1330) II 3, XIX 40
entries.english: Pfahl von Grünsfeld – Anna, wife of Johann – (1330) II 3, XIX 40. The index introduction explains that these references give the collection volume and item (Quadrangel) numbers.

guesses.content: may be the Anna identified in the Personenindex as the wife of Johann under Pfahl von Grünsfeld; the index does not give Johann's given name or identify Anna as von Rosenberg.
